reason: The quote says an event source must point to the correct alias or version, otherwise the function won't use provisioned concurrency environments; it sits in the provisioned concurrency configuration steps, so 'correct' means the one with provisioned concurrency.
The quote states verbatim that you can't allocate more provisioned concurrency than reserved concurrency for a function; same scope (per function) and no extra condition.

Quote 1 gives the public-subnet clause (no internet access, no public IP); quote 2 gives private subnets reaching the internet through the NAT gateway; quote 3 lists subnets, NAT gateway, internet gateway and route table entries created by the Create VPC workflow.

The quotes never name Fargate or say the billing is for the vCPU and memory you select; that scope stands only in the surrounding text. They do support per-second billing with one-minute minimum regardless of requests, and Lambda by requests and duration in milliseconds.
